entities.summary: Mario Addison is an American former professional football player who was a defensive end in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Troy Trojans. He was signed by the Chicago Bears as an undrafted free agent in 2011. After being cut and spending time as a reserve for the Indianapolis Colts and Washington Redskins, Addison was signed by the Carolina Panthers, playing on their defensive line for eight seasons before signing with Buffalo in 2020. He then played one year for the Houston Texans.
